edges.reason: msg.sender drives buyer identity and accounting in buyToken without an is_started or access gate.
buyToken calls predict_token_value to convert msg.value into tokens.
amount_in_wei parameter is multiplied by presale.token_rate in the returned value.
predict_token_value reads presale.token_rate.
total_transfer_amount local stores the predict_token_value result.
transfer_amount local derives from total_transfer_amount and percent_on_purchase.
buyToken increments presale.token_sold.
buyToken accumulates amount_spend_per_user[msg.sender] with msg.value.
buyToken accumulates presale_purchased_per_user[msg.sender].
buyToken accumulates presale_received_per_user[msg.sender].
buyToken requires buy_allowance_left_by_user(msg.sender) to exceed msg.value.
buy_allowance_left_by_user reads presale.max_buy_limit.
buy_allowance_left_by_user reads amount_spend_per_user[_address].
_address parameter indexes the amount_spend_per_user mapping.
Unchecked-style subtraction of spend from max_buy_limit yields the remaining allowance.
buyToken forwards msg.value to the presale funding address via an external value transfer.
External value transfer to a recipient can re-enter buyToken before/around token delivery.
buyToken calls _transfer to deliver presale tokens after the external ETH transfer.
Overridden _transfer calls filter_blacklist(msg.sender) before moving balances.

_transfer enforces locked_timestamp < block.timestamp for locked wallets.
_transfer debits and credits _balances entries.
sender parameter indexes _balances and locked address lists.
recipient parameter is credited in _balances.
amount parameter is compared with senderBalance and subtracted.
